chosen.title: girl running during sunset ties her shoelaces
chosen.faces: none visible (hair covers face while bent over; body only)
chosen.why: Only candidate where the actual bend is on screen: the runner stops at 6.0s and folds from standing between 6.3s and 6.8s; at 6.6s arms are clearly reaching down and hands touch the shoe at 6.8s, so the 0.7s cut is the descent plus lace grab. Wide back/front-low angle on a city promenade, natural golden-hour light, 16:9 1080p, no text/logos. Downside: strong orange sunset grade and flare (to be tamed in grading) and the shoe is small in frame.

alternates.why: Close-up of a foot with hands dropping into frame at 0.2-0.5s to grab the laces; reads as reaching down but the torso bend is not visible. No face. 720p only, very saturated blue shoe/bottle and a blown-out white background.
Clean urban crouch-and-tie close-up under a bridge, natural light, no face, muted tones. Already crouched from frame 0 so it reads 'tying' not 'bending'; 720p only.

notes: Sheets: tying shoelaces (5), tying shoes (3), runner tying sneakers (0), shoelaces (8), lacing sneakers (1), putting on sneakers (1, irrelevant). 101368/101369 thumbnails failed to load and were skipped. 40136 and 50105 rejected for visible faces; 16231 downloaded but is a crouched hands close-up with no bend and only 5.4s (pink nails, dirt trail). Only 4851 was available in 1080p; the other three candidates are 720p.
